He previously played for the [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]] and [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn Tigers]]. ==High school career== Kessler played basketball for [[Woodward Academy]] in [[College Park, Georgia]]. In his senior season, he averaged 17.8 points, 9.3 rebounds and 5.2 blocks per game, leading his team to its first Class 4A state title. Kessler was named ''[[The Atlanta Journal-Constitution]]'' Player of the Year, [[Mr. Georgia Basketball]] and Georgia [[Gatorade Player of the Year awards|Gatorade Player of the Year]].{{cite web = yes }} ==College career== === North Carolina (2020–2021) === On March 10, 2021, Kessler posted 16 points, 12 rebounds and eight blocks in a 101–59 win over [[Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball|Notre Dame]] in the second round of the [[2021 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament|ACC Tournament]]. He set a North Carolina freshman record and an ACC Tournament record for blocks in a game.{{cite web |title=Bacot, UNC beat Notre Dame 101-59, advance to ACC quarters |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2021/03/10/bacot-unc-beat-notre-dame-101-59-advance-to-acc-semis/43459333/ |website=[[USA Today]] |publisher=[[Associated Press]] |access-date=April 13, 2021 |date=March 10, 2021}} As a freshman, he averaged 4.4 points and 3.2 rebounds per game. === Auburn (2021–2022) === Following the season, Kessler transferred to [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]], choosing the Tigers over [[Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball|Gonzaga]].{{cite web |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |title=Sought-after center Walker Kessler, one of the top players in the men's basketball transfer portal, commits to Auburn Tigers |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31245075/sought-center-walker-kessler-one-top-players-men-basketball-transfer-portal-commits-auburn-tigers |website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=April 13, 2021 |date=April 12, 2021}} On December 29, 2021, he posted a [[triple-double]] of 16 points, a career-high 11 blocks and 10 rebounds against [[LSU Tigers basketball|LSU]].{{cite news |last1=Wilborn |first1=Nubyjas |title=Walker Kessler gets triple-double in Auburn's 70-55 win and other thoughts from Auburn Arena |url=https://www.al.com/auburnbasketball/2021/12/walker-kessler-gets-triple-double-in-auburns-70-55-win-and-other-thoughts-from-auburn-arena.html |access-date=December 30, 2021 |work=[[Al.com]] |date=December 29, 2021}} On January 25th, Kessler received SEC Player of the Week honors following strong performances against [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Georgia]] and [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]].{{Cite web|url=https://auburnwire.usatoday.com/2022/01/25/jabari-smith-walker-kessler-earn-sec-honors/|title=Jabari Smith, Walker Kessler earn SEC Honors|date=25 January 2022}} Kessler was regarded one of the nations premier shot blockers, setting the Auburn single season block record, leading the nation in blocks and recording more blocks than all but 13 teams.{{Cite web|url=https://flywareagle.com/2022/02/17/auburn-basketball-kessler-blocks-stat/|title = Auburn basketball: This Walker Kessler blocks stat is ridiculous|date = 17 February 2022}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.al.com/auburnbasketball/2022/02/walker-kessler-breaks-auburns-single-season-blocks-record.html|title = Walker Kessler breaks Auburn single-season blocks record in win vs. Ole Miss|date = 24 February 2022}} At the conclusion of the regular season, Kessler was named the SEC Defensive Player of the Year, a member of the All-SEC First Team and a [[2022 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|3rd Team All American]]. {{cite web | url=https://247sports.com/college/auburn/Article/Auburns-Walker-Kessler-SEC-Basketball-Defensive-Player-of-the-Year-184036415/ | title=Walker Kessler SEC Basketball Defensive Player of the Year }}{{cite web | url=https://apnews.com/article/sports-wisconsin-indiana-georgia-basketball-cffd2113c69053c28aa220a71ca94d69 | title=The Associated
